title: Treatment of Prisoners with Serious Health Conditions Who Are Prone to Infections
what_it_is: Treatment of Prisoners with Serious Health Conditions Who Are Prone to Infections

sections.label: Inmate healthcare and specialist treatment
sections.summary: SPS healthcare aligns with national standards; inmates with complex conditions may be treated at public healthcare institutions and National Specialty Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) has a healthcare delivery system that is aligned with national standards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Inmates receive appropriate levels of primary medical care within the Prison Medical Complex.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the case of inmates with complex medical conditions, medical experts may advise that there is a need for highly specialised treatment, which is not available in the Complex, unless our prisons are to be outfitted to be exactly like public healthcare institutions (PHIs) and National Specialty Centres (NSCs), with the same type of medical expertise – which is not a sensible option.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In such cases, the inmate may receive his/her treatment at the PHIs and NSCs.

sections.label: Medical care protocols for inmates
sections.summary: Medical care protocols and a healthcare system are in place to manage inmates with varying conditions.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Maybe the Member is not aware of what we have in place.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have medical care protocols in place and a healthcare system that can manage inmates with varying conditions.

sections.label: Prison healthcare standards and audits
sections.summary: Prison healthcare standards are similar to outside, include negative pressure cells for infection control, and are regularly audited by the Ministry of Health.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Practically, you will find the standards very similar to what you can get outside.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We also have negative pressure cells for infection control, for example, COVID-19 or even tuberculosis.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: To that extent, ours is not something very different from what you see outside.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are also subjected to inspection or audits by the Ministry of Health regularly.

sections.label: Medical advisory and review boards
sections.summary: A medical advisory panel and an external placement review board exist, and the matter is not for Prisons alone to decide.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I think it is an option that Prisons can take on and this is not something relating to what Prisons can decide.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have a medical advisory panel and we have an external placement review board.
